answer:
The song **"Turn Me On"** by **Norah Jones** (the performer of *Live from Austin, TX*, a 2007 live concert recording) was written by **John D. Loudermilk**. 

The original version of the song was recorded and released by Mark Dinning in 1961 as the B-side to his single "Lonely Island."
